fingerprint_version.description: Projection version the subject_hash was computed with (audit-subject-v1)

subject_hash.description: SHA-256 of the reviewed facts, from pipeline/load/review_subjects.py. The loader applies a decision only while this equals the record's current hash; without it a review is evidence that cannot confirm.

subject_snapshot.description: Optional copy of the hashed subject, for reproducibility

subject_type.description: What record_id names: a match (pair) or a location (endpoint). C7 / #57
